notes:
Account summary:
- Large trading firm building latency-sensitive scoring + chat ops for traders. Evaluating Redwood Dedicated for primary inference path; Private control plane for compliance layer.
- Primary objectives: predictable throughput, firm latency SLOs, and contractual uptime guarantees with clear credit schedule.
SLA / procurement notes (high priority):
- Target uptime: customer requests 99.99% for production cluster, 99.9% acceptable for DR/standby. Need explicit definition (regional vs. cluster).
- Credit schedule proposal from procurement team: 5% credit for <99.99% but >=99.95%; 15% credit for <99.95% but >=99.9%; 40% credit for <99.9%. Legal pushed back on unlimited credits — negotiating cap at 50% annual invoice.
- Maintenance windows: prefer 02:00-05:00 ET monthly, require notification 14 days prior for planned maintenance >30m. No maintenance during earnings windows (quarterly blackout).
- Support SLA: P1 (platform down affecting production): initial response 15 minutes, mitigation plan within 1 hour; P2: response 1 hour, mitigation 4 hours. Want named engineering on-call escalation path and weekly status until resolved.
- Reserved GPU planning: initial commitment 16 x A100-equivalent GPUs (2 clusters, 8 GPUs each) for 200 sustained RPS at 512-token avg; capability to burst +50% for market events. Ask for explicit allocation model (guaranteed v. best-effort) and preemption rules.
- Throughput & latency targets: p95 generation latency <= 75ms for production routes at target batch sizes; p99 budgeted at 200ms. Need profiling run with our tail workloads (long-context scoring + short chat) before final sizing.
- Model/version pinning: must be able to pin model versions per-route and rollout canary with automatic fallback to a smaller quantized variant. Also need KV cache persistence across warm restarts.
- Network & routing: require private VPC peering, egress controls, and ability to route by policy (latency-first primary region, cost-tier fallback).
- Observability: token-level cost breakdown, per-route latency histograms, and audit logs retained 2 years for compliance team.
